# Sirach Chapter 35 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 35 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_035_page_001.jpg

---

**35:1** Whoever keeps the law multiplies offerings; whoever heeds the commandments sacrifices a peace offering.

**35:2** Whoever shows gratitude offers fine flour; whoever gives to charity sacrifices a thank offering.

**35:3** To refrain from evil is pleasing to the Lord, and to refrain from unrighteousness is an atonement.

**35:4** Do not appear before the Lord empty-handed, for all these things are in fulfillment of the commandment.

**35:5** The righteous man's offering enriches the altar, and its pleasing odor rises before the Most High.

**35:6** The sacrifice of a righteous man is acceptable, and its memorial will never be forgotten.

**35:7** Honor the Lord generously, and do not reduce the firstfruits of your hands.

**35:8** With every gift show a cheerful face, and dedicate your tithe with gladness.

**35:9** Give to the Most High as he has given to you, generously, according to your means.

**35:10** For the Lord is one who repays, and he will repay you sevenfold.

**35:11** Do not offer him a bribe, for he will not accept it, and do not trust to a dishonest sacrifice; for the Lord is the judge, and with him there is no partiality.

**35:12** He will not show partiality against a poor man, and he will listen to the prayer of one who is wronged.

**35:13** He will not overlook the supplication of the fatherless, or the widow when she pours out her complaint.

**35:14** Do not the tears of the widow run down her cheek? And is not her cry against the one who causes them to fall?

**35:15** The one who serves God wholeheartedly will be accepted, and his prayer will reach to the clouds.

**35:16** The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds, and it will not rest until it reaches its goal; it will not desist until the Most High responds,

**35:17** and renders judgment for the righteous and executes justice. And the Lord will not delay, nor will he be slow to act on their behalf,

**35:18** until he crushes the loins of the merciless and repays vengeance on the nations; until he takes away the multitude of the insolent and breaks the scepters of the unrighteous;

**35:19** until he requites man according to his deeds, and the works of men according to their devices; until he judges the case of his people and makes them rejoice in his mercy.

**35:20** Mercy is welcome in time of distress, like rain clouds in time of drought.
